Function Arguments Position

Source: R/intern_.fun_args_pos.R
dot-fun_args_pos.Rd

Return the positions of the first function name found in a string, of its opening and closing brackets, and of each pair of brackets between them.

Usage

.fun_args_pos(text, pattern, lib_path, error_text)

Arguments

text

Single string, whose brackets between quotes have been replaced (see .in_quotes_replacement()).

pattern

Single string: Perl regex matching the function name and its opening bracket, generally paste0(<FUNCTION_NAME>, "[\\s\\r\\n]*\\(").

lib_path

Vector of character strings or NULL: the lib_path value of the calling exported function, only passed on to arg_check(). No default value.

error_text

Single character string added to the error messages to name the calling functions (embed_error_text of the calling function). NULL is converted into "". No default value.

Value

A list containing positions in text:

  • begin_fun: position of the first character of the first match of pattern.

  • begin: position of the opening bracket ( of the function.

  • end: position of the closing bracket ) of the function.

  • middle_bracket_pos: list of the positions of each pair of brackets between begin and end: in each compartment, the position of ( and the position of the matching ). NULL if no bracket.

Details

An internal error is returned if pattern is not found in text, if no ( follows it, or if its closing bracket is not found (e.g., bracket between quotes not replaced). Its message contains an excerpt of text. No file is written.

Warnings:

  • requires saferDev::arg_check.

  • In the safer Backbone section "######## check of the required functions from the required packages", add also saferDev::arg_check when checking for the presence of .fun_args_pos.
